details.description:
Large undead

GM: An eye-tyrant that refused to stop existing. Its dead lair is still guarded by the zombies of everyone who came for its hoard.

Solo: Eye tyrant. A normal creature of its Level unless the GM runs it as a solo (tick Run as solo before the fight). As a solo: it fights in three phases with this HP in each; at 0 HP its next phase starts at full HP (damage beyond 0 is lost) and every condition and hostile effect on it ends; at its first phase change only, its breath weapons and other limited-use abilities recover (never spells); once a round, so for the rest of a round in which it changed phase damage can't take it below 1 HP; at 0 HP in its third phase it dies (all automatic). It acts twice a round, on its initiative and again 10 lower (the second turn repeats its attacks, never a spell or limited ability). Villain actions: the eye tyrant type's three (in its abilities, worked out for its Level); the opener straight after the first enemy turn, the crowd control after the turn that starts its second phase, the ultimate after the turn that starts its third; it skips its second turn in a round it uses one, if that turn is still to come. Anything that stops it acting, attacking, moving or casting, or banishes, imprisons or petrifies it, ends after two of its turns (one, the second time in a fight), then nothing of the kind affects it until the end of the following round. A kill effect deals damage equal to its current HP (yours to apply). A lasting area, aura or ongoing effect damages it once a round, at the start of its first turn, however many of its turns or moves pass through it; a spell that deals its damage when cast works as normal.

As a normal creature: its HP once, one turn a round, no villain actions and no shaking it off. Its breath weapon, and any spell or other power that hits more than one creature, deals half damage, and its attacks deal no more than the Damage target for its Level in a round (27).

system.description: Immune to poison, sleep, charm and fear. Cannot be knocked @Condition[prone]{Prone}.
Its central eye shines a 150ft cone. Creatures in it cannot regain HP, and any humanoid that dies in it rises as a zombie under its control at the start of its next turn.

Once per round, as part of its action, three different random rays (roll 1d10 each) at creatures within 120ft: 1 charm (@Check[will|dc:18]{Will DC 18} or @Condition[charmed]{Charmed} for 1 hour); 2 paralysing (@Check[fort|dc:18]{Fortitude DC 18} or @Condition[paralysed]{Paralysed} 1 minute, repeating the save); 3 fear (@Check[will|dc:18]{Will DC 18} or @Condition[frightened]{Frightened} 1 minute); 4 slowing (@Check[ref|dc:18]{Reflex DC 18} or half speed and only one attack for 1 minute); 5 enervation (@Check[fort|dc:18]{Fortitude DC 18} for half of @Damage[8d8 necrotic]{8d8 necrotic damage}); 6 telekinesis (@Check[fort|dc:18]{Fortitude DC 18} or moved 30ft and @Condition[restrained]{Restrained} until its next turn); 7 sleep (@Check[will|dc:18]{Will DC 18} or @Condition[unconscious]{Unconscious} 1 minute); 8 petrification (@Check[fort|dc:18]{Fortitude DC 18} or @Condition[petrified]{Petrified}, after a second failed save on its next turn); 9 disintegration (@Check[ref|dc:18]{Reflex DC 18} for half of @Damage[10d8 force]{10d8 force damage}; a creature reduced to 0 HP is turned to dust); 10 death (@Check[fort|dc:18]{Fortitude DC 18} for half of @Damage[10d10 necrotic]{10d10 necrotic damage}; a creature reduced to 0 HP dies).
A Perception check: a Wisdom check the creature is trained in.

It fires two random eye rays at different creatures within 120ft, each with its own numbers.

An eye tyrant solo's opener (Running a Solo, Monsters & Treasure). Every rider lasts until the end of the target's next turn.

Each enemy within 60ft that it can see makes a @Check[fort|dc:21]{Fortitude save DC 21}, taking @Damage[4d6 necrotic]{4d6 necrotic damage} and falling @Condition[prone]{Prone} on a failure, or half damage on a success.

An eye tyrant solo's crowd control (Running a Solo, Monsters & Treasure). Every rider lasts until the end of the target's next turn.

It fires three random eye rays, all at one creature within 120ft.

An eye tyrant solo's ultimate (Running a Solo, Monsters & Treasure). Every rider lasts until the end of the target's next turn.
